Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the following posts:
1) Medical Physicist
Qualification & Experience:
Should be M.Sc. Medical Physics from a recognized Indian University and possess an outstanding academic record and should have experience of having in the Radiotherapy Department in a Medical College for at least three years.
2) Data Base Administrator
Qualification & Experience:
Should be an Oracle Certified Associate (OCA from ORACLE) and a Science Graduate of an Indian University. Should have actively participated in designing, executing and implementing an electronic hospital information system & should have worked with a reputed software development team. In addition, candidate should have at least 5 years experience of administrating oracle database for an advanced Hospital Information System in a teaching hospital attached to a medical college.
3) Superintendent, Girls Hostel
Qualification & Experience:
Should be a graduate with 5 years experience in a Hostel of Medical Institute.
4) Sister Tutor
Qualification & Experience:
Should be R.N.R.M., PBBSc. with 3 years of teaching experience in a Nursing School or College.
5) Clinical Instructor
Qualification & Experience:
Should be R.N.R.M., PBBSc. with one year of teaching experience in a Nursing School or College.
The applicant should apply along with complete bio-data and necessary academic certificates/testimonials to the Secretary Office, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS). The last date for the submission of application is 30
th
May 2015.
Pay Scale: As per 6
th
Pay Commission
Age Limit: 35 years. Age & Qualification can be relaxed for exceptional / experienced candidates as per the recommendation of Selection Committee.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
